name: Sunita Devi
quote: Maine kabhi socha nahi tha ki main ghar se bahar nikal kar job kar sakti hoon. NayiUdaan ne mujhe woh yakeen diya. Aaj mujhe itni khushi hai.
quoteEn: I never imagined stepping out and working. NayiUdaan gave me that belief. Today I am so proud.

name: Meghna Iyer
role: Returnship after 5-year break → Product Manager at Zoho
quote: After 5 years of raising my children, I thought my career was over. The AI roadmap and mock interview practice gave me the confidence I needed to walk into Zoho's office.
quoteEn: After 5 years of raising my children, I thought my career was over. The AI roadmap gave me the confidence to walk into Zoho's office.

name: Phoolmati Yadav
quote: Tailoring course seekhke mera apna boutique hai ab. Ek mahine mein 12,000 rupaye kamaati hoon. Mera beta proud hai mujhse.
quoteEn: After learning tailoring, I now have my own boutique. I earn ₹12,000 a month. My son is proud of me.

name: Rashida Begum
quote: I was married at 16 and never finished school. But the digital literacy program changed my life. Now I run a banking access point and serve my whole village.
quoteEn: I was married at 16 and never finished school. Now I run a banking access point and serve my whole village.

name: Dr. Smita Kulkarni
role: Career Break (Caregiving) → Senior Developer at Persistent
quote: I took a 3-year break to care for my mother. I thought 'who will hire me now?' NayiUdaan's resume optimizer made me realise I had more skills than I knew. Persistent hired me within 6 weeks.
quoteEn: I took a 3-year break to care for my mother. NayiUdaan made me realise I had more skills than I knew. Persistent hired me in 6 weeks.

name: Kamla Bai
quote: Ghar ka kaam chhod ke main ab hospital mein kaam karti hoon. Apni beti ko doctor banana chahti hoon. NayiUdaan ne mujhe rasta dikhaya.
quoteEn: I left domestic work and now work at a hospital. I want to make my daughter a doctor. NayiUdaan showed me the way.
